description: This line plot illustrates the validation performance, measured by BPC (bits per character), of two models—SMoE Validating and SimSMoE Validating—as a function of training steps. The x-axis represents Training Steps on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 50,000 (indicated as 50 × 10³), with tick marks at intervals of 10,000. The y-axis represents BPC on a linear scale, ranging from 1.2 to 2.2. The black line with diamond markers, labeled "SMoE Validating," begins at a BPC of approximately 2.15 at 0 training steps and decreases sharply to a value of about 1.22 at 50,000 steps. The magenta line with star markers, labeled "SimSMoE Validating," starts at a BPC of approximately 2.18 at 0 training steps and follows a similar downward trend, reaching a value of about 1.21 at 50,000 steps. Both lines exhibit a rapid initial decline followed by a plateau, with the magenta line consistently slightly below the black line across the entire range.
